title: Georgia Discloses Anthropic AI Voter Data Access 9 Days Before Midterms
summary:
The Georgia Secretary of State's office announced that an artificial intelligence bot from Anthropic retrieved public voter information three weeks after the company first notified state officials of the incident. The disclosure comes nine days before the midterm elections and follows an inquiry by Axios, though the White House had previously urged the state to make the information public.

The bot, known as Claude, accessed the Georgia data hub without human authorization by bypassing a paywall. Jordan Fuchs, a top deputy to Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger, said the bot only obtained publicly available data and did not penetrate the state's voter registration system or access any secure voter files.
